# calendar

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/calendar"
```

Package calendar is a month in a grid with a cursor on a day: the arrows move a day or a week, pgup and pgdown a month, and enter chooses the day. Nothing reads the clock: the app says which day is today.

## Constants

<a name="Width"></a>Width and Height are the cells View always takes: seven days of two cells with a gap, under the month and the weekdays, over six weeks.

```go
const (
    Width  = 7*3 - 1
    Height = 2 + weeks
)
```

<a name="Chosen"></a>
## type [Chosen](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/calendar/events.go#L7>)

Chosen is the event of a day chosen: enter, or a click on the day already under the cursor. Day is at midnight.

```go
type Chosen struct{ Day time.Time }
```

<a name="Keys"></a>
## type [Keys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/calendar/calendar.go#L33-L37>)

Keys are the bindings that move the cursor and choose a day. Each pair's second has no help of its own: the first names both.

```go
type Keys struct {
    Left, Right, Up, Down key.Binding
    PrevMonth, NextMonth  key.Binding
    Enter                 key.Binding
}
```

<a name="DefaultKeys"></a>
### func [DefaultKeys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/calendar/calendar.go#L41>)

```go
func DefaultKeys() Keys
```

DefaultKeys are the arrows for a day and a week, pgup/pgdown for a month and enter to choose.

<a name="VimKeys"></a>
### func [VimKeys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/calendar/calendar.go#L55>)

```go
func VimKeys() Keys
```

VimKeys are DefaultKeys with vim's letters added: h/l for a day, k/j for a week and ctrl\+b/f for a month.

<a name="Model.Update"></a>
### func \(Model\) [Update](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/calendar/calendar.go#L178>)

```go
func (m Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (Model, bezel.Result)
```

Update moves the cursor on its keys, held within WithRange; enter, or a click on the day already under the cursor, reports a [Chosen](<#Chosen>). A click on another day of the grid moves there. Anything else comes back unhandled.

<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/calendar/calendar.go#L64-L72>)

Styles are how a calendar paints its parts.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Title    lipgloss.Style // the month and year
    Weekday  lipgloss.Style // the row of weekday names
    Day      lipgloss.Style // a day of the month shown
    Outside  lipgloss.Style // a day of the month before or after
    Today    lipgloss.Style
    Cursor   lipgloss.Style // the day under the cursor
    Disabled lipgloss.Style // a day out of WithRange
}
```

<a name="DefaultStyles"></a>
### func [DefaultStyles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/calendar/calendar.go#L76>)

```go
func DefaultStyles(th theme.Resolved) Styles
```

DefaultStyles bold the month, mute the weekdays and the days around it, mark today in the accent and the cursor as the caret.
